  • +54%Confidence in their self-regulation skills
  • +22%How often they felt safe
  • +21%How strongly they felt safe
  • −23%How often they shut down
  • −23%How strongly they shut down
  • −14%How strongly they froze up
  • −9%How often they froze up
  • −15%How often they went into fight
  • +27%Healthy fight energy: feeling empowered

Self-reported by the first cohort. Results vary. Read the study

You're overwhelmed with wellness

You try stuff here and there, and nothing really sticks. You just want to get unstuck. You want something simple. You want it to make sense. You want actual skills you can use and master. And you're ready to make it happen.

Self-Regulation Simplified is an 8-week, cohort-based program for people who already have some familiarity with feeling safe, but feel frustrated by their self-regulation efforts so far. If you're ready for a structured, supportive way to gently connect with your body's stuck defenses, this is for you.

How it's different

Instead of exercises from a guru that sort of help for a little while and then get forgotten, you learn, practice, and master essential self-regulation skills.

Gradual
Over 8 weeks, each skill builds on the one before. Nothing is overwhelming or out of reach.
Practical
Every week has a short lesson on one self-regulation skill, followed by homework you can act on. You build new capacities into your daily life, not just learn theory.
Permission to pause
If a skill feels too challenging, stopping is not failure. It's honoring your own nervous system's timeline and capacity. It just means you've found where to focus. Rejoin a cohort when you're ready to move on.
Community
You practice with others, so you benefit from connecting with people (co-regulation), a key ingredient for learning to calm yourself, especially after trauma or disrupted attachment.
Expertise
Led by Justin, a member of the Polyvagal Institute Editorial Board. The curriculum is grounded in Polyvagal Theory: self-regulation means deeply connecting with safety, then gradually easing stuck defense.

The skills you'll build

You don't need more theory, more gurus, or more influencer "advice." You need real skills. Over the eight weeks, you'll learn, practice, and build:

  • Deeply connecting with what safety feels like in your body
  • Validating and normalizing your defenses
  • Inviting defensive activation with compassion
  • Recognizing and handling obstacles to self-regulation
  • Balancing defense with safety
  • Moving back and forth between safety and defense (pendulation)
  • Describing what's happening inside you, in depth
  • Recognizing how your body wants to move

Is it for you?

It's a good fit if:
  • You're frustrated with your self-regulation efforts and want a clear, step-by-step, guided approach.
  • You're ready to move beyond coping and distraction and build real skills for lasting change.
  • You can feel safe some of the time and don't know what to do next, or you want to deepen your sense of safety.
  • You want a simple, direct approach.
  • You want to master essential self-regulation skills and stop relying on psychobabble and woo-woo.
Please don't join if:
  • You're looking for a quick fix or a hack.
  • You want to spend time with "parts," ego, shadows, and so on.
  • You're not willing to be an active member of a cohort.
  • You aren't willing to practice the skills between meetings.

Why it works

Self-regulation is a skill you can learn, practice, and keep improving. That builds your ability to handle distress and a healthier emotional baseline.

Safety first

Each skill begins in safety, stays in safety, and ends in safety.

Gradual

Each skill builds on the last in small, sustainable steps.

Compassion and defense

Self-regulation happens when defense is met with compassion and balanced with safety.

Measured

The first cohort reported less time stuck in defense, more confidence, and a stronger felt sense of safety.

Questions

What if it's too difficult?

You're strongly encouraged to stay within your capacity. Every student progresses at their own speed, and that's expected and built into the eight weeks.

Do I need to attend every week?

Yes. You're expected to begin with the others in week 1 and keep meeting.

How soon will I see results?

It depends on many factors, so it's hard to say, and no specific outcome is guaranteed. Students in the first cohort saw real changes by week 4. See the data in the study.

Is it recorded? Can I watch the replays?

Yes, meetings are recorded, and you can watch the replays of the meetings you attend. If you leave the cohort, you won't get access to the other meetings. Replays are for attendees, to keep practicing the skills and reflect on the discussions they took part in.

Does this replace therapy?

Definitely not. But it can be a great supplement to therapy. Please talk it over with your provider(s).

What happens after the 8 weeks?

You can join a future Self-Regulation Simplified cohort while you're an Academy student. The Academy has plenty of other live sessions too.

More questions? I'm happy to answer them personally: justin@stucknotbroken.com.
